title: Game Industry Layoffs Reached 14,800 Despite Record-Sales Headlines
hook: Game industry layoffs reached 14,800; record-sales headlines did not protect workers.
closing: An industry's success story can hide workers losing jobs, so sales totals alone do not explain job security.
question: What would make gaming careers more secure?

segments.say: Game industry layoffs reached 14,800 in the latest supplied year. Cuts climbed sharply across the measured period.
The rest of the industry lost 12,000 jobs in the company breakdown. Headline companies were only part of the cuts.
